scripts.build:contracts: pnpm --dir packages/desktop-contracts run build && pnpm --dir packages/emulator-protocol run build
scripts.package:tauri:mac: pnpm run build:contracts && tauri build --target aarch64-apple-darwin --bundles app,dmg --config src-tauri/tauri.release.conf.json
scripts.package:tauri:win: pnpm run build:contracts && tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --bundles nsis --config src-tauri/tauri.release.conf.json
scripts.test:updater: vitest run src/appUpdateStartup.test.ts && cargo test --offline --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml updates
scripts.test: pnpm --dir packages/desktop-contracts run test && pnpm --dir packages/emulator-protocol run test && pnpm run test:renderer && pnpm run test:release-build && pnpm run test:release-publish
scripts.test:e2e: npm --prefix ../dartsnut-community-api run test:e2e && pnpm run test:e2e:agent
